14.1.en: Krishna: "Here's the highest knowledge again. Sages who knew this reached perfection."
14.1.hi: Krishna: "Ye raha sabse ooncha gyaan phir se. Jo rishi ise jaante the, woh perfection tak pahunche."

14.2.en: Those who get this become like me. They're not reborn or shaken at the end of the world.
14.2.hi: Jo ye samajhte hain, woh mere jaise ho jaate hain. Na dobara janam, na pralay mein hilte hain.

14.3.en: Nature is like the womb of the universe, and I plant the seed. That's how all life begins.
14.3.hi: Prakriti brahmaand ki kokh jaisi hai, aur beej main daalta hoon. Aise sab jeevan shuru hota hai.

14.4.en: Every life form comes from nature as the mother, and I'm the father.
14.4.hi: Har jeev prakriti maa se aata hai, aur pita main hoon.

14.5.en: Three energies, goodness, passion and inertia, keep the soul tied to the body.
14.5.hi: Teen energies, sattva, rajas aur tamas, aatma ko body se baandhe rakhti hain.

14.6.en: Goodness is clean and bright, but even it can trap you through attachment to happiness and knowledge.
14.6.hi: Sattva saaf aur roshan hai, par woh bhi khushi aur gyaan ke attachment se phansa sakta hai.

14.7.en: Passion comes from craving and attachment, and it hooks you on constant activity. Hustle-culture energy.
14.7.hi: Rajas craving aur attachment se aata hai, aur tumhe lagataar kaam ka addict banata hai. Hustle culture energy.

14.8.en: Inertia comes from ignorance and traps you with laziness, carelessness and too much sleep.
14.8.hi: Tamas agyaan se aata hai aur aalas, laparwahi aur zyada neend se phansata hai.

14.9.en: Goodness chains you to happiness, passion to work, and inertia to carelessness.
14.9.hi: Sattva khushi se baandhta hai, rajas kaam se, aur tamas laparwahi se.

14.10.en: These three compete constantly. Sometimes one wins, sometimes another. Your mood is the scoreboard.
14.10.hi: Ye teeno lagataar compete karte hain. Kabhi ek jeetta hai, kabhi dusra. Tumhara mood scoreboard hai.

14.11.en: When clarity and understanding shine through all your senses, goodness is in charge.
14.11.hi: Jab har sense se clarity aur samajh chamke, tab sattva in charge hai.

14.12.en: Greed, restlessness, taking on too much and constant craving: that's passion in charge.
14.12.hi: Laalach, bechaini, zyada kaam utha lena aur lagataar craving: ye rajas in charge hai.

14.13.en: Darkness, laziness, carelessness and confusion: that's inertia in charge.
14.13.hi: Andhera, aalas, laparwahi aur confusion: ye tamas in charge hai.

14.14.en: Leave the world in a state of goodness and you go to the higher, purer realms.
14.14.hi: Sattva ki halat mein duniya chhodo toh oonche, shuddh lokon mein jaate ho.

14.15.en: Leave in passion and you're born among workaholics. Leave in inertia and you're born into dullness.
14.15.hi: Rajas mein jaao toh workaholics mein janam. Tamas mein jaao toh susti bhari jagah janam.

14.16.en: Good deeds lead to purity, passion leads to pain, and inertia leads to ignorance.
14.16.hi: Achhe karm se shuddhta, rajas se dukh, aur tamas se agyaan milta hai.

14.17.en: Goodness brings wisdom, passion brings greed, inertia brings carelessness and confusion.
14.17.hi: Sattva gyaan laata hai, rajas laalach, tamas laparwahi aur confusion.

14.18.en: Live in goodness and you rise. Live in passion and you stay stuck. Live in inertia and you sink.
14.18.hi: Sattva mein jiyo toh upar uthte ho. Rajas mein toh wahin atke rehte ho. Tamas mein toh neeche girte ho.

14.19.en: See that these three energies are behind every action and know what's beyond them. Then you reach me.
14.19.hi: Dekho ki har action ke peeche ye teen energies hain aur jaano inke pare kya hai. Tab mujh tak pahunchoge.

14.20.en: Rise above all three and you're free from birth, death, ageing and pain.
14.20.hi: Teeno se upar utho toh janam, maut, budhape aur dukh se free ho jaate ho.

14.21.en: Arjuna: "How do I spot someone who's gone beyond all three? How do they act?"
14.21.hi: Arjun: "Jo teeno se pare chala gaya, use kaise pehchanun? Woh kaise behave karta hai?"

14.22.en: They don't resent clarity, busyness or confusion when it comes, and don't miss it when it goes.
14.22.hi: Clarity, busyness ya confusion aaye toh unse chidte nahi, aur jaaye toh miss nahi karte.

14.23.en: They sit back like an observer. "Oh, it's just the energies doing their thing." Unshaken.
14.23.hi: Woh observer ki tarah baithte hain. "Arre, ye toh bas energies apna kaam kar rahi hain." Atal.

14.24.en: Same in pleasure and pain. Dirt, stone and gold look the same to them. Calm with praise or blame.
14.24.hi: Sukh-dukh mein same. Mitti, patthar aur sona sab ek jaise. Taareef ya burai mein shaant.

14.25.en: Same in honour and insult, with friends and enemies, not chasing ego projects. They're beyond the energies.
14.25.hi: Izzat-beizzati mein same, dost-dushman ke saath same, ego projects ke peeche nahi. Woh energies se pare hain.

14.26.en: Those who love and serve me steadily rise above all three and reach the ultimate.
14.26.hi: Jo mujhe lagataar pyaar aur seva karte hain, woh teeno se upar uthke ultimate tak pahunchte hain.

14.27.en: I'm the foundation of the ultimate: eternal, unchanging truth and complete bliss.
14.27.hi: Main ultimate ki neev hoon: amar, kabhi na badalne wala sach aur poora anand.
